verses.text: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.

segments.text: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.

verses.text: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.

segments.text: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.

verses.text: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

segments.text: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.

verses.text: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

segments.text: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.

verses.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

segments.text: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

verses.text: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.

segments.text: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.

verses.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

segments.text: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.

verses.text: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—do not abandon the works of Your hands.
